sarah_condition: Sarah feels well during a routine Mars transit shift.
charm_assessment: Routine baseline. Nothing indicates a bleeding event.
alert_basis: Stable personal baseline; no reported bleeding or warning symptoms.
required_checks: Continue routine HR and BP monitoring; confirm previously recorded baseline.
immediate_action_steps: Continue normal activity and routine monitoring.
equipment: Wearable HR monitor; BP cuff; pulse oximeter if available.
measurement_sources: Wearable/resting HR; BP cuff; symptoms and bleeding from crew report.

sarah_condition: Sarah reports visible external bleeding after an accidental equipment-related injury during maintenance.
symptoms: Localized discomfort; awake, responsive, and speaking normally.
bleeding_observation: Visible bleeding reported by crew; quantity not measured
bleeding_control_status: Crew begins approved first-aid bleeding-control measures
charm_assessment: Reported bleeding requires assessment even when vital signs remain near baseline.
alert_basis: Crew-confirmed bleeding; initially stable vital signs compared with baseline.
required_checks: Crew medical assessment of ongoing bleeding and response to basic control measures; repeat BP, HR, RR and symptoms.
laboratory_tests: None routinely at this early stage; consider only if medically indicated and available.
immediate_action_steps: Alert the Crew Medical Officer; use approved first-aid bleeding-control steps; pause maintenance and reassess.
equipment: First-aid dressings and gloves, if available; wearable monitor; BP cuff.
treatment_guidance: Use trained-crew first aid and mission protocol; do not infer injury severity from pulse alone.
measurement_sources: Bleeding status and symptoms: crew-reported; vitals: monitor/cuff.

sarah_condition: The crew reports that bleeding has not yet been fully controlled.
symptoms: Fatigue and increased awareness of heartbeat; remains oriented.
bleeding_observation: Ongoing bleeding reported; not quantitatively measured
alert_title: CAUTION - Persistent Bleeding and Rising Heart Rate
charm_assessment: Persistent visible bleeding with a rising heart rate raises concern for evolving blood loss. No definitive loss volume or shock diagnosis is inferred.
alert_basis: Continued bleeding plus rising resting HR; trends require crew assessment.
required_checks: Urgent Crew Medical Officer reassessment; repeat HR, BP, RR, mentation and bleeding-control status.
laboratory_tests: CBC / hemoglobin only if medical officer indicates and onboard assay is available; do not delay control for labs.
immediate_action_steps: Continue authorized control measures; maintain close observations; escalate if bleeding persists or symptoms develop.
equipment: Approved bleeding-control first-aid kit, HR monitor, BP cuff; analyzer only if available.
treatment_guidance: Crew medical protocol directs control and escalation; CHARM does not choose invasive procedures or drugs.
measurement_sources: Bleeding and symptoms: crew report; HR: wearable; BP: cuff.

sarah_condition: Bleeding persists and Sarah becomes lightheaded while resting.
symptoms: Lightheadedness, weakness and paleness reported by crew; awake and responsive.
charm_assessment: Multiple signs suggest worsening circulatory status; urgent hands-on medical assessment is necessary.
alert_basis: Persistent bleeding + weakness/lightheadedness + faster HR + falling BP relative to baseline.
required_checks: Frequent vital-sign reassessment, responsiveness and bleeding status; assess for further deterioration.
laboratory_tests: Laboratory testing only when available and appropriate; initial normal hemoglobin would not exclude acute loss.
immediate_action_steps: Urgent Crew Medical Officer involvement; continue authorized bleeding control; closely observe Sarah; prepare emergency response.
equipment: First-aid bleeding-control supplies; BP cuff; HR monitor; pulse oximeter if available.
treatment_guidance: Escalate under approved medical protocol; no autonomous therapy or medication advice.
measurement_sources: Bleeding, pallor, lightheadedness: crew-assessed; vitals: device/cuff.

sarah_condition: Sarah becomes too dizzy to continue her tasks. Bleeding is still an active concern.
symptoms: Severe weakness and near-fainting; requires immediate crew assessment.
bleeding_observation: Uncontrolled or incompletely controlled bleeding reported
alert_title: CRITICAL - Bleeding with Low Blood Pressure
charm_assessment: Potential hemorrhage-related circulatory instability. An urgent emergency medical response is required; this is not a diagnosis derived from HR alone.
alert_basis: Continuing bleeding + SBP 86 mmHg + marked tachycardia + severe symptoms.
required_checks: Immediate trained-crew ABC and circulation assessment; continuous/repeated BP, HR, RR, responsiveness and bleeding-control checks.
laboratory_tests: Do not delay emergency response for CBC or other laboratory measurements.
immediate_action_steps: Activate the mission medical emergency protocol; notify responding crew; continue first-aid control led by trained crew; document observations.
equipment: Approved emergency first-aid kit; BP/HR monitor; mission-specified medical supplies if available.
treatment_guidance: Only trained crew and the Crew Medical Officer may direct emergency care according to authorized protocol; no doses or procedures selected by CHARM.
measurement_sources: Bleeding and symptoms: clinical crew report; vital signs: monitors/cuff.

sarah_condition: Communication with Earth becomes unavailable while crew medical care is underway.
symptoms: Ongoing critical event; no new symptom assessment documented at this step.
bleeding_observation: Last known: bleeding was not confirmed controlled at Stage 5
bleeding_control_status: Current control status awaiting fresh crew report
alert_title: CRITICAL - Earth Link Unavailable; Onboard Protocol Active
charm_assessment: No new measurements are supplied. Local guidance and incident log remain accessible; last-known readings must never be displayed as live.
alert_basis: Prior critical medical state persists pending reassessment; Earth-link outage is a separate communication event.
required_checks: Continue actual onboard monitoring and obtain fresh crew clinical assessments; mark stale or unavailable values clearly.
laboratory_tests: No new laboratory values supplied; do not invent results.
immediate_action_steps: Keep cached mission-approved guidance available; record all crew actions locally and maintain emergency response; sync later if technically supported.
equipment: Local CHARM interface; offline protocol copy; onboard monitoring and approved emergency supplies.
treatment_guidance: Continue trained-crew medical care per approved onboard protocol even without ground contact.
last_known_measurements_note: Last known from Stage 5: HR 132 bpm, BP 86/56 mmHg, RR 28/min, SpO2 98%. LAST KNOWN ONLY; NOT LIVE.
trend_direction: Critical carried forward; no new numeric sample
measurement_sources: Only communication and prior-stage information supplied; new vitals intentionally absent.

sarah_condition: Crew reports bleeding is now controlled following authorized care and Sarah is less dizzy.
symptoms: Reduced lightheadedness and fatigue; awake and communicating.
bleeding_control_status: Controlled by trained crew; watch for recurrence
charm_assessment: Improving signs following crew-led treatment do not mean automatic medical clearance.
alert_basis: Control reported; BP, HR and symptoms improving, but recent critical instability requires observation.
required_checks: Repeat BP/HR/RR, assess bleeding recurrence, mental state and symptoms; follow medical-officer plan.
laboratory_tests: CBC / hemoglobin trend if clinician requests and an onboard test is genuinely available.
immediate_action_steps: Continue observation and documentation; confirm bleeding remains controlled; do not return to full duty yet.
equipment: Wearable, BP cuff, first-aid kit, optional laboratory device if present.
treatment_guidance: Continue clinician-directed follow-up; CHARM does not select treatment.
measurement_sources: Control confirmed by crew; symptoms reported; fresh vitals simulated.

sarah_condition: Repeated crew assessments show stable vital signs near Sarah's demo baseline and no recurrent bleeding.
symptoms: Dizziness resolved; feels well; Crew Medical Officer follow-up remains planned.
bleeding_observation: No recurrent bleeding on repeat crew checks
charm_assessment: Return toward baseline after medical review. The simulation resolves the urgent alert, but only an authorized clinician can clear return to duty.
alert_basis: Stable repeat readings, symptoms resolved and crew-confirmed continued bleeding control.
required_checks: Scheduled reassessment and symptom check; document bleeding-control and injury follow-up.
laboratory_tests: Any follow-up blood testing only if clinically indicated and available.
immediate_action_steps: Complete incident documentation; continue planned check-ins; medical officer decides return-to-duty readiness.
equipment: Routine HR/BP monitoring; follow-up first-aid supplies as directed.
treatment_guidance: Follow the Crew Medical Officer's aftercare plan; no autonomous clearance.
measurement_sources: Repeat crew report + simulated vital signs.
